name: typekafka
description: typekafka — Type-safe Kafka messaging on Node.js & TypeScript: outbox, retry topic, DLQ, idempotent consumer, OTel traces

scripts.dev:producer: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace apps/producer
scripts.dev:consumer: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace apps/consumer
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:customer-view: npm run build --workspace apps/customer-view && npm run dev --workspace apps/customer-view
